verdict.rationale: Galileo documents Experiments that evaluate prompts, models and application code against chosen metrics, with a Python SDK and custom metrics. This means evals can plausibly be scripted, but nothing in the pack shows them running in a CI pipeline or gating a deployment on their results. Missing for 10: documented CI integration (e.g. GitHub Actions or a CLI runner), pass/fail thresholds or exit codes for deployment gating, programmatic experiment-run docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
